description: Open A2UI v1.0 messages as a screen on a phone and return it as a tree. The messages are the agent's own: createSurface, updateComponents, updateDataModel, deleteSurface. Needs no app. Then use screen, tap, type and screenshot on the session like any app, a2ui_send to change the screen and a2ui_actions to read what the person did.

messages.description: A2UI messages, each { version: "1.0", createSurface | updateComponents | updateDataModel | deleteSurface: {...} }

model.description: Phone model from phone_models, for example 'iPhone 16 Pro' (default: Pixel 8)

name: a2ui_open
